2609.18453.title: The Mirage of Calibrated Confidence: Trajectory-Independence of Verbalized Confidence in Vision-Language Models
2609.18453.paper_summary: A calibrated Vision-Language Model (VLM) can repeatedly self-correct, say "Wait, I should recheck," arrive at the wrong answer, and still report high confidence. We find that this occurs because verbalized confidence is largely trajectory-independent in the VLMs and calibration methods we evaluate. We examine this through three complementary lenses: content variation, token masking, and the model's own hesitation markers. We show that confidence is insufficiently sensitive to what the reasoning trajectory actually contains, and that calibration training can paradoxically worsen this disconnect. Since existing metrics like ECE and AUROC cannot detect this problem, we propose the Trajectory-Grounding Score (TGS) in two complementary forms: TGS-self, which compares confidence with and without access to the model's own trajectory, and TGS-pair, which tests whether the model assigns higher confidence to correct trajectories than to flawed ones along the vision, reasoning, and answer axes. We propose TGS-Bench, a model-agnostic suite spanning 10 benchmarks with controlled good/bad trajectory pairs, and show that conventional calibration rankings diverge from trajectory-grounding rankings, exposing a blind spot in current evaluation practice.
2609.18453.paper_summary_zh: 一個經過校準的視覺-語言模型（VLM）可以不斷自我修正，說「等等，我應該重新檢查」，即使得出錯誤答案，仍然報告高信心。我們發現這種情況發生的原因是，在我們評估的 VLM 和校準方法中，口頭表達的信心在很大程度上與軌跡無關。我們通過三個互補的視角來檢視這一點：內容變化、標記掩蔽和模型自身的猶豫標記。我們顯示信心對推理軌跡實際內容的敏感性不足，並且校準訓練可能會矛盾地加劇這種脫節。由於現有的指標如 ECE 和 AUROC 無法檢測到這個問題，我們提出了兩種互補形式的軌跡基準分數（TGS）：TGS-self，將信心與是否訪問模型自身的軌跡進行比較，以及 TGS-pair，測試模型是否在視覺、推理和答案軸上對正確軌跡賦予比錯誤軌跡更高的信心。我們提出了 TGS-Bench，一個模型無關的套件，涵蓋 10 個基準，具有控制良好/不良軌跡對，並顯示傳統的校準排名與軌跡基準排名存在偏差，揭示了當前評估實踐中的盲點。
